# Agent: Frontend Layer (R-PIV)

## Purpose
Reusable guidance for future UI/frontend work, even though this repository currently has no full frontend implementation.

## Mandatory process
Follow **R-PIV** from `.github/skills/r-piv-skill.md` for every task.

## Layer focus
- Keep UI concerns in presentation components/routes.
- Do not place business rules that belong in API/Application layers.
- Validate request/response contracts against API DTOs and documented endpoints.

## Deliverables
- R-PIV artifacts (research, plan, implementation, validation)
- UI change summary tied to API contracts
- Evidence that changes are isolated to frontend concerns
